Build information

Source: R/info.R
zupdf_info.Rd

Reports the bundled pdfio version, the patches applied to it, the zlib it was linked against, the pdfio features this build lacks, and the default limits.

Usage

zupdf_info()

Value

A list of class zupdf_info with elements:

  • pdfio_version: version of the bundled pdfio, e.g. "1.6.5". Its ttf library ships inside the same release.

  • patches: the local patches applied to it, in order.

  • zlib_version: version of the zlib linked at build time.

  • absent: features of later pdfio releases this build lacks, such as "lzw" decoding.

  • limits: the default max_size, max_objects, max_stream, max_depth and max_pages of pdf_open().

  • smoke_ok: TRUE if the bundled pdfio wrote a one-page file in memory.

Examples

zupdf_info()
#> <zupdf_info>
#> pdfio:       1.6.5
#> patches:     0001-visibility-override, 0002-no-stdio, 0003-date-buffer, 0004-undefined-behaviour, 0005-unsigned-shifts, 0006-dict-getstring, 0010-ttf-callbacks
#> zlib:        1.3
#> absent:      lzw, gif, object_streams, page_accessors, windows_unicode_paths
#> max_size:    1073741824 bytes
#> max_objects: 1000000
#> max_stream:  268435456 bytes
#> max_depth:   64
#> max_pages:   100000
#> self-test:   ok
